hero.title: RPG Skills
hero.subtitle: Level up. Choose your class. Dominate the world. An RPG progression mod with 33 classes, XP system, passives, actives, and controller support.
features.label: What the mod adds
features.title: Full Progression
features.subtitle: A clear and satisfying loop: XP → Level → Class Points → Dominate the world.
features.card1.title: XP System
features.card1.text: Earn XP from enemies, mining, fishing, farming, and settlement work. Configurable XP curve and death penalty.
features.card2.title: 33 Classes
features.card2.text: War Master, Arcane Master, Cavern Master, Construction Master, and more. Each class offers unique passives and actives. Toggle via config.
features.card3.title: QoL Shop
features.card3.text: XP buffs (2x, 5x, or 10x), extra chest slots (base 40, max 400, config up to 1000), larger world stacks, and Explosive Miner. All with balanced economy.
features.card4.title: Full Config
features.card4.text: In-game menu to configure progression, classes, passives, shop economy, and mod compatibility.
features.card5.title: Controller
features.card5.text: Full controller support. LB+RB to open window, D-pad to navigate, A to confirm. Works in SP and MP.
features.card6.title: Compatibility
features.card6.text: Compatible with Safe Haven QOL 3.5. Compat options in the RPG Skills menu. Safe Haven config is no longer overwritten.

progression.title: The Progression Loop
progression.xp.title: XP Sources
progression.xp.combat.desc: Kill monsters and bosses. Forest gives 15 XP, Dungeon 25, Deep Temple 70, Incursions up to 105. Bosses yield 300–1,900 XP.
progression.xp.mining.desc: Break blocks, chop trees, harvest plants. Each action is 5 XP. Explosive Miner clears area but no extra XP.
progression.xp.fishing.desc: Cast the rod for 5 XP per cast, not per fish. Plant and harvest: 5 XP each. Works AFK with Angler's Reflex.
progression.xp.settlement.desc: Help settlers, recruit NPCs, do tasks. Each activity gives 5 XP. Realm Master 5 triples it.
progression.config.title: Configuration
progression.config.curve.desc: Level 1 needs 10k; level 165 needs 1.65M. Want easier or harder? Tune the curve in the menu. Total to 165 is ~136 million.
progression.config.death.desc: Dying costs 25% of current-level XP. Too harsh? Disable with one click. Respec costs 1,000 coins per level.
progression.config.respec.desc: Bad build? Use /rpgskills reset points or the menu to refund. On big updates, the mod refunds automatically.
progression.config.economy.desc: 2×/5×/10× buffs last 10 minutes. Chest +10 slots and bigger stacks with fair scaling prices.

funcionalidades.systems.label: Everything the mod adds
funcionalidades.sys1.title: XP System
funcionalidades.sys1.text: Killed a monster? You got XP. Mined, fished, farmed, or helped settlers? Same. Dangerous places pay more. On death you lose some current-level XP — and you can turn that off in settings.
funcionalidades.sys1.link: → See details in XP Universe
funcionalidades.sys2.title: 33 Classes
funcionalidades.sys2.text: Warrior for melee, Arcane for magic, Miner, Fisher, and more. Each class goes to level 5 and unlocks unique powers.
funcionalidades.sys3.title: In-game shop
funcionalidades.sys3.text: Spend in-game coins on: XP boosts for 10 minutes, more chest space, and bigger stacks. Fair prices.
funcionalidades.sys4.title: Simple config
funcionalidades.sys4.text: An in-game menu to toggle what you want: active classes, XP gains, death XP loss, and more. An “RPG SKILLS CONFIG” button on the main menu.
funcionalidades.sys5.title: Works with a controller
funcionalidades.sys5.text: Hold LB+RB to open, use the D-pad to navigate and A to confirm. 3 tidy tabs — no keyboard needed.
funcionalidades.sys6.title: Plays nice with other mods
funcionalidades.sys6.text: Works with Safe Haven 3.5 without conflict. If Safe Haven is detected, overlapping features turn off automatically.
funcionalidades.sys7.title: Auto weapon swap
funcionalidades.sys7.text: The game spots nearby enemies and swaps to the right weapon — sword, bow, staff, or summon — without pausing the fight.
funcionalidades.sys8.title: Food lasts longer
funcionalidades.sys8.text: Food used to spoil whole stacks. Now only 1 unit at a time. Supplies last longer — and you can turn it off.
funcionalidades.sys9.title: Combined damage
funcionalidades.sys9.text: Burn, poison, and frost on the same foe? A blue number shows total damage per second — easy to read.
funcionalidades.formula.label: How leveling works
funcionalidades.formula.examples: Level 2 → 20,000 XP • Level 10 → 100,000 XP • Level 50 → 500,000 XP
funcionalidades.formula.tip: 💡 Tip: at level 42 you've already spent about 9 million total XP. Cap (165) totals ~136 million.
funcionalidades.xpcount.title: ⚖️ How XP is counted
funcionalidades.xpcount.text: The game takes base XP, applies your shop boost (2×/5×/10× for 10 min) and the global multiplier, then rounds to a multiple of 5. Simple and fair.
funcionalidades.death.title: 💀 What if I die?
funcionalidades.death.text: You lose 25% of current-level XP. Example: with 10,000 banked, you lose 2,500. Turn it off in the menu if it feels harsh.
funcionalidades.economy.label: Rewards
funcionalidades.eco1.title: More chest space
funcionalidades.eco1.text: Starts at 40 and goes to 400 (up to 1000 in config). Each purchase adds +10 slots.
funcionalidades.eco2.title: Giant stacks
funcionalidades.eco2.text: Items stack up to 1,000× instead of 100. Each tier costs coins + gold bars.
funcionalidades.eco2.note: Cheap early, expensive at the top
funcionalidades.eco3.title: XP boost
funcionalidades.eco3.text: Buy 2×, 5×, or 10× for 10 minutes. Great for tough areas.
funcionalidades.eco.tip: 💡 Tip: Explosive Miner costs 100k + materials and unlocks when Cavern hits level 5. Worth it!
progressao.loop.label: The heart of the mod
progressao.loop.hint: Click each step to see what happens. You're already doing this without noticing!
progressao.loop.step1.body: No need to change your style. Like fighting? Mining? Fishing? Settlements? Everything levels you up. The mod rewards what you already enjoy.
progressao.loop.step1.tip: 💡 Dangerous zones like Deep Temple or Incursions give up to 7× more XP than the starting forest.
progressao.loop.step2.body: Combat gives 15–105 XP per foe; mining and fishing give 5 XP per action. Even recruiting settlers pays. Harder places pay more.
progressao.loop.step2.tip: Ex: Forest 15 XP • Cave 40 XP • Deep Temple 70 XP • Boss 300–1,900 XP
progressao.loop.step3.body: Each level needs 10,000 more than the last. Level 1 needs 10k; level 50 needs 500k. You get exactly 1 point per level, up to 165.
progressao.loop.step3.tip: Use the simulator below to try any level!
progressao.loop.step4.body: Spend points across 33 classes. Each goes to level 5 and unlocks unique powers. Like magic? Focus Arcane. Prefer building? Go Construction.
progressao.loop.step4.tip: You can respec later for coins if you change your mind.
progressao.loop.step5.body: With new powers, once-impossible areas get easy. You return to hard Incursions, earn even more XP, and the cycle restarts. It's addictive!
progressao.loop.step5.tip: That's the fun: you feel growth every session.

progressao.tip1.title: Go Deep
progressao.tip1.text: Deep Forest already pays 45 XP, Deep Temple 70. About 3× surface. Risk more, earn more.
progressao.tip2.title: Time your buff
progressao.tip2.text: Save 10× for Incursion or Boss. Ten minutes of 10× in Scrapyard Incursion beats hours in the forest.
progressao.tip3.title: Play with friends
progressao.tip3.text: XP is shared in a 24-block radius. In a party or settlement, everyone grows together.

changelog.v2_5.i8: Adjustable economy (cost, buff duration, settlement rate)

changelog.v2_4.i4: Loot Master: dynamite/bombs no longer multiply drops repeatedly

fontes.card.title: Everything in one place
fontes.card.text: To avoid repeating content on two pages, we merged Detailed Sources into the XP Universe. There you'll find the 4 tiers, bosses, and now per-activity details with practical examples.
fontes.card.tip: 💡 Tip: use the Surface / Caves / Incursions filter there to focus on what matters for your level.

fontes.preview.settle.sub: Tasks 5 XP, recruit up to 15, 3× with Realm 5

universo.boss.card.title: Bosses
universo.boss.card.sub: The higher your level, the more they pay
universo.boss.card.ex: Ex: killing the boss at level 100 equals 86 forest slimes!
universo.miniboss.card.title: Mini-bosses
universo.miniboss.card.ex: Easier than bosses, but already pay very well.

universo.details.label: Details that matter
universo.details.subtitle: What looks the same isn't always. See what changes in practice.
universo.details.combat.i1: Animals give 5 XP, but your summons give nothing
universo.details.combat.i2: Mini-bosses must be large or special. Worth zone XP +100
universo.details.combat.i3: Boss at level 50 already pays 800 XP. At 100, 1,300!
universo.details.combat.i4: Ex: 10 Forest enemies (15 each) + 5× buff = 750 XP
universo.details.mining.i1: Blocks with items give 5 XP. Grass and cobweb don't
universo.details.mining.i2: Explosives break a lot, but only the targeted block counts
universo.details.mining.i3: Liquids like water and lava give no XP
universo.details.mining.i4: Tip: 200 blocks = 1,000 XP at your pace
universo.details.fish.i1: Fishing counts per cast, not per fish. Even AFK works
universo.details.fish.i3: Harvesting too fast has a short cooldown to avoid duplicates
universo.details.settle.i1: Tasks give 5 XP each, up to 150 per minute
universo.details.settle.i4: With Realm level 5, everything is worth 3× more!
universo.details.integrated: 💡 This was the Detailed Sources content, now integrated here
universo.calc.label: Do the math
universo.calc.subtitle: Pick where you'll play and see instantly. No math!
universo.calc.tip: A level-100 boss already pays 1,300 XP alone!
universo.tips.label: Veteran tips
universo.tip1.title: Go where it pays more
universo.tip1.text: At level 1, Forest is great. At 30, go Deep. At 80+, Incursion only.
universo.tip2.title: Use the right boost
universo.tip2.text: Save 10× for a boss or hard Incursion. Ten minutes of 10× beats hours without a boost.
universo.tip3.title: Play together
universo.tip3.text: Near friends (24 blocks) XP is shared. Settlement with Realm 5 gives up to 3× more.

explore.card.discussoes.title: Discussions
explore.card.discussoes.desc: Send questions, suggestions, and attachments straight to the author's email.
meta.desc.discussoes: Send questions, suggestions, and feedback about RPG Skills. Name, email, message, and attachments go to the author.
discussoes.title: Discussions & Feedback
discussoes.subtitle: Questions, suggestions, bugs, or ideas. Your message goes straight to the author's inbox. You can attach images and files — up to 10 MB total.
discussoes.aside.label: How it works
discussoes.aside.title: Private email delivery
discussoes.aside.text: This is not a public forum. Your message goes straight to the author’s email, and replies go to the email you provide.
discussoes.aside.li1: Name and email so I can reply
discussoes.aside.li2: Clear message: bug, suggestion, question, or feedback
discussoes.field.name: Name
discussoes.ph.name: Your name
discussoes.ph.message: Describe what happened, your suggestion, or question...
discussoes.success.title: Message sent!
discussoes.success.text: Thank you. I'll reply to the email you provided as soon as I can.
discussoes.error.required: Please fill in name, email, and message.
discussoes.error.size: Attachments together exceed 10 MB. Remove some files and try again.
discussoes.limit.lead: If you're sending an image, screenshot, log, or file, keep these limits in mind:
discussoes.limit.li1: 10 MB total per submission (all files combined)
discussoes.limit.li2: You can attach up to 3 files, as long as they fit in 10 MB total
discussoes.limit.li3: Accepted: PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, PDF, TXT, LOG, ZIP, MD
discussoes.limit.li4: If you go over the limit, sending is blocked before it leaves
discussoes.limit.tip: Tip: large screenshots or photos? Compress them or crop to what matters.
discussoes.form.title: Write your message
discussoes.form.sub: Fields marked * are required. Attachments are optional.
discussoes.field.email.hint: Used only so I can reply to you. Never published.
discussoes.files.intro: You can send up to 3 files (screenshots, logs, etc.). All of them together must stay under 10 MB.
discussoes.files.types: PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, PDF, TXT, LOG, ZIP, MD
discussoes.files.warn: If you exceed 10 MB, submit stays blocked until you remove a file.
discussoes.submit.note: After sending, you'll return here with confirmation.
